title: MIME parser: no limit on multipart part count (DoS vector)
description: core/ipld/mime_parser.rs: parse_multipart() accumulates parts into a Vec with no upper bound. A crafted message with 10,000 empty MIME parts (each separated by the boundary) creates 10,000 MimePart objects. Article size limits bound total bytes but not structural complexity. Fix: add a limit (e.g., 100 parts) and return a parse error if exceeded.
